a.lede: David Durman, a University of Kentucky administrator, recently earned a religious exemption from using AI in the workplace.
a.title: You don’t need to believe in a god to get a religious exemption from using AI at work

b.lede: A research administrator at the University of Kentucky was granted a Title VII exemption, allowing them to not use AI tools as it goes against their moral beliefs.
b.title: Man granted first-of-its-kind religious exemption against mandatory AI use at work
